text.tspan: derived-credit
Release physical guard only after catcher
restoration, marker invalidation, caller cleanup and
roster handoff; an acknowledgement loss retains
original custody
execution-owner
Register durable VM/session and root custody before
entering throw-capable native activation; guard
identity is not continuation identity
call-catcher
Pop only the current call catcher; matching return
performs fp and PSR0 restoration, mismatched return
propagates to restored outer catcher
storage-commit
Exclude all active guards, retained exported
handles, invocation authorities and roster debt
before VM retirement; separate from run return
outer-catcher
Existing cleanup CFUN restores outer catcher before
R_ALL_INL and conversion cleanup; AT_END lies inside
TRY success arm and is not all-path finally
marker-guard
Stable guard owns allocated marker and invalidates
it once on bypass; allocation failure must not
invent an initialized marker
reload-cleanup
Spill/reload, conversion resources, result/error
propagation and any last caller PSTATE access
precede stable release; physical guard cannot be
replayed by continuation
run-participant
Secondary processor forwards error then participates
forever in sync ops; only acknowledged
roster/storage handoff can replace that duty

g.text: SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source + platform OPEN

text.tspan: guard-coverage
Safety gain; no current throughput claim. CFUN
conversion cleanup already exists and cannot be counted
again
session-sharing
Net work positive only saved lease work exceeds
receipt, roots and retention costs; current code is not
this comparator
caller-retirement
Can retire duplicate ownership policy, never erase
required semantic cleanup or old-roster duties by
assertion
modern-c-baseline
Zig offers no proved extra GC/session safety or runtime
savings here; modern C remains required
